autoDiscover.title: Auto Discover
autoDiscover.description: Automatically find the PVS6 on your local network via mDNS. When enabled, Host and Serial Number are ignored. If the device becomes unreachable for 2 hours, discovery runs again automatically.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the PVS6. Ignored when Auto Discover is enabled.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Full PVS6 serial number. The last 5 characters are used as the login password. Ignored when Auto Discover is enabled.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the PVS6 for new data. Minimum 5 seconds.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish Solar and Grid (import/export combined) over Matter as electrical sensors with live power and cumulative/periodic energy, feeding your Apple Home Energy view. Home Consumption is not published over Matter, since its energy is derived from Solar + Grid rather than an independent measurement. Requires Homebridge 2.3.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge; skipped safely otherwise.

throttleUpdates.title: Throttle power updates
throttleUpdates.description: Only send an Eve Watts update to HomeKit when the power has changed meaningfully, crossed to/from 0, or the heartbeat interval has passed. Also adds hysteresis to the Solar Production On switch (on above 50 W, off below 20 W, each state held at least 5 minutes). Turn off to send every poll, as in earlier versions.

minChangeWatts.title: Minimum change (W)
minChangeWatts.description: Send an update when power has changed by at least this many watts (or the percentage below, whichever is larger) since the last value sent.

minChangePercent.title: Minimum change (%)
minChangePercent.description: Send an update when power has changed by at least this percentage of the last value sent (or the watts above, whichever is larger).

maxIntervalSeconds.title: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
maxIntervalSeconds.description: Send the current power anyway once this long has passed since the last update, even if it hasn't changed much.

grid.title: Enable Grid Meter accessories (Import + Export pair)

homeConsumption.title: Enable Home Consumption accessory
homeConsumption.description: Shows real-time site load and derived lifetime consumption energy.

solarName.title: Solar Accessory Display Name
solarName.description: HomeKit display name for the Solar Production accessory.

gridName.title: Grid Import Accessory Display Name
gridName.description: HomeKit display name for the Grid Import accessory.

gridExportName.title: Grid Export Accessory Display Name
gridExportName.description: HomeKit display name for the Grid Export accessory.

homeConsumptionName.title: Home Consumption Accessory Display Name
homeConsumptionName.description: HomeKit display name for the Home Consumption accessory.

layout.title: Throttling
layout.description: Reduce how many HomeKit events the plugin sends for power readings.
